parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json||{}; const args=source.args&&typeof source.args==='object'?source.args:source; const tool=String(source.tool||''); const query=String(args.query||'').trim(); const limit=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(args.limit||10),50)); let url=''; if(tool==='contacts.get'){const resource=String(args.resourceName||'').trim(); if(!resource)return[{json:{ok:false,error:'resourceName is required.',tool}}]; url=`https://people.googleapis.com/v1/${resource}?personFields=names,emailAddresses,phoneNumbers,organizations`; } else if(['contacts.search','contacts.resolve_recipient'].includes(tool)){if(!query)return[{json:{ok:false,error:'Contact query is required.',tool}}]; url=`https://people.googleapis.com/v1/people:searchContacts?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&readMask=names,emailAddresses,phoneNumbers,organizations&pageSize=${limit}`;} else return[{json:{ok:false,error:`Unsupported Contacts tool: ${tool}`,tool}}]; return[{json:{...source,ok:true,tool,url,query}}];

const source=$('Normalize Contacts Request').item.json||{}; const data=$json||{}; const ok=!data.error&&!data.message; const rows=Array.isArray(data.results)?data.results.map(r=>r.person||{}):[data]; function render(p,i){const name=p.names?.[0]?.displayName||'(no name)';const emails=(p.emailAddresses||[]).map(e=>e.value).filter(Boolean);const phones=(p.phoneNumbers||[]).map(e=>e.value).filter(Boolean);return `${i+1}. ${name}${emails.length?' | '+emails.join(', '):''}${phones.length?' | '+phones.join(', '):''}${p.resourceName?' | '+p.resourceName:''}`;} const visible=rows.filter(r=>r&&Object.keys(r).length); let text=visible.length?visible.slice(0,10).map(render).join('\n'):(ok?'No matching contacts.':String(data.error?.message||data.message||'Google Contacts request failed.')); return[{json:{ok,tool:source.tool,text,result:visible,links:[],meta:{ambiguous:source.tool==='contacts.resolve_recipient'&&visible.length!==1,count:visible.length}}}];
